# PlayCounter

> Free Windows app that tracks how long you play your PC games, from any launcher, disc or emulator. Import Steam and Xbox hours and your Battle.net games.

- Public Windows release: 1.2.0. Coming soon to Steam.
- Free desktop app; no PlayCounter account required. Desktop source is MIT-licensed. The current production API is private.
- Automatic tracking follows recognized running games, regardless of launcher. Unknown or ambiguous games can be reviewed locally in Discovered.
- Imports: Steam (local account files, with playtime), Xbox (optional Microsoft sign-in; playtime availability varies by game) and Battle.net (optional: installed games or account sign-in, game list only, no historical playtime; Battle.net games are tracked without it).
- Imported and adjusted totals do not recreate sessions. For a matched game, the displayed total is the higher of the PlayCounter total (tracked sessions plus any manual adjustment) and the sum of the imported launcher totals, counting each launcher once.
- Earlier hours from launchers without a playtime import can be set with Adjust total playtime; a single missed session can be logged with its date.
- Dedicated per-game emulator detection: DOSBox, Dolphin and PCSX2. Recognition depends on exposed game identifiers, files or titles.
- Recorded sessions and history stay on the PC. Matching, metadata, updates and pseudonymous installation presence use online services; optional imports have additional data flows.
